answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. Top-1 agreement 0.865, sequence agreement 0.344, TV 0.146, Token-DiFR gap 0.529 and raw-score shift ÷ TV 3.7 all sit at or just beyond the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908, 0.31-0.48, 0.108-0.144, 0.28-0.52, 3.3-3.9). KL 0.429 is above the system-prompted range (0.197-0.339), but it points even further from the other categories. Fine-tuned tops out at KL 0.205, top-1 0.938 and TV 0.099, and its raw-score ratio has a wider spread (3.1-10.8). Quantized has KL at most 0.071 and a ratio of about 2.2, so it is ruled out. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but the values are too large for it.
